changeSet.sql: UPDATE billing_rule SET is_default = FALSE WHERE billing_item_type = 'SERVICE' AND is_default = TRUE;

INSERT INTO billing_rule ( name, billing_item_type, billing_trigger, is_default, created_by, created_date, last_modified_by, last_modified_date ) SELECT 'Default Service Encounter Billing', 'SERVICE', 'ENCOUNTER_CREATED', TRUE, 'system', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'system', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM billing_rule WHERE billing_item_type = 'SERVICE' AND billing_trigger = 'ENCOUNTER_CREATED' );

UPDATE billing_rule SET is_default = TRUE, last_modified_by = 'system', last_modified_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ( SELECT id FROM billing_rule WHERE billing_item_type = 'SERVICE' AND billing_trigger = 'ENCOUNTER_CREATED' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1 );
